parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:db8:2::1/64
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及前缀长度。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols bgp group external-peers t.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers type external

set protocols bgp group external-peers p.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers peer-as 100

set protocols bgp group external-peers n.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers neighbor 2001:db8:2::2

parameters.name: router-id
parameters.explanation: BGP路由器的ID，通常为一个IPv4地址。

set protocols bgp group external-peers f.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet6 unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers f.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers family inet6 unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers f.explanation: 配置BGP组支持IPv6单播地址族。

set protocols bgp group external-peers n.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] family inet6 unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers n.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers neighbor 2001:db8:2::2 family inet6 unicast
set protocols bgp group external-peers n.explanation: 配置BGP组邻居支持IPv6单播地址族。

set protocols bgp group external-peers e.command: set protocols bgp group external-peers export redistribute-connected

set policy-options policy-statement redi.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement redi.command: set policy-options policy-statement redistribute-connected term 1 from protocol direct
set policy-options policy-statement redi.explanation: 配置策略语句的匹配条件为直接路由。

set policy-options policy-statement redi.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set policy-options policy-statement redi.command: set policy-options policy-statement redistribute-connected term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement redi.explanation: 配置策略项的动作接受。
